title: User preferences
description: The whole 'preferences' state document (/config/preferences.json). Unlike the other schemas here it describes a full document, not one entry in a collection, since preferences has no array/map of entries.

display_name.description: How the user wants to be addressed. May be empty.

agent_name.description: The agent's display name: shown in the UI and used by instructions with an {agent_name} placeholder. One line, at most 32 characters; empty means the default 'Progena'. Display only, never an identifier.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'UTC'). Used to schedule tasks and display timestamps.

theme.description: UI color theme. 'system' follows the OS light/dark preference.

nav_collapsed.description: Whether the primary nav rail renders collapsed to icons-only.

pinned_panel.description: Which right-hand panel, if any, is docked open instead of floating as a modal. null means none pinned.

notification_sounds.description: Whether a chime plays alongside the toast when an alert arrives.

quick_chat_thread_id.description: Thread id of the default-mode quick chat's scratch conversation, so a pinned quick chat can rehydrate after a page reload. null means no persisted thread.

last_open_chat_thread_id.description: Thread id of the last chat conversation the user viewed on the Chat page (once it has at least one message), so navigating to Chat without an explicit id reopens it instead of starting a new chat. null means none yet.
